He is Swazi and speaks Swati.

58871.etyen:
Derived from English Swazi, from Zulu iSwazi, ultimately from Mswati, the regnal name of Mswati II, also known as Mswazi II. During his nineteenth-century reign, the name came to be applied to the people united under his rule.
The corresponding Swazi forms are liSwati (“one Swazi person”) and emaSwati (“the Swazi people”); compare siSwati (“the Swazi language”) and eSwatini (“Eswatini”). The deeper etymology of the personal name Mswati is uncertain.
Compare Norwegian Nynorsk swazi, Danish swazi, Swedish swazi, German Swasi, Dutch Swazi and English Swazi.
